name: National Disability Insurance Scheme
eligibility: Generally for eligible people with permanent and significant disability who meet age, residency, disability or early intervention requirements.
description: Funding for reasonable and necessary disability supports, including support coordination, assistive technology and home modifications where criteria are met.

name: Carer Payment
eligibility: For carers who provide constant care to a person with disability, a medical condition, or an adult who is frail aged, subject to Services Australia rules.
description: Income support payment for eligible carers whose caring role prevents full-time work.

name: Carer Allowance
eligibility: For eligible carers who provide daily care and attention to someone who needs it, subject to Services Australia rules.
description: Supplementary payment that may be available alongside other income support payments.

name: Disability Support Pension
eligibility: For people who meet both non-medical and medical rules for Disability Support Pension.
description: Income support for eligible people with permanent physical, intellectual or psychiatric conditions that affect ability to work.

name: Support at Home
eligibility: For eligible older Australians after aged care assessment through My Aged Care.
description: Support at Home includes services, equipment and home modifications for eligible people to remain at home.

name: EnableNSW Equipment Allocation Program
eligibility: For eligible NSW residents with specific short-term or ongoing health needs; check EnableNSW criteria.
description: Provides new and refurbished equipment through EnableNSW for eligible people.

name: Medical Aids Subsidy Scheme
eligibility: For eligible Queenslanders with permanent or stable conditions or disabilities who meet MASS criteria.
description: Subsidy funding for medical aids and equipment, including daily living, mobility, communication, continence and palliative equipment schemes.

name: Victorian Aids and Equipment Program / SWEP
eligibility: For eligible Victorian residents with permanent disability or frailty who meet VA&EP/SWEP program rules.
description: Subsidised aids, equipment and selected home or vehicle modification supports.

name: Community Aids and Equipment Program
eligibility: For eligible Western Australians with long-term health, disability or age-related functional impairment living at home.
description: Provides equipment and home modifications to support function, independence, safety and unpaid carers.

name: TasEquip
eligibility: For eligible Tasmanians prescribed equipment by an authorised therapist or prescriber and meeting program criteria.
description: Provides a range of equipment to help eligible Tasmanians with everyday tasks at home.
